planSteps.description: Navigate to /app?election=upload and wait for the 'ballots-input' textarea
Clear the 'ballots-input' textarea completely so it is empty and click 'run-count'
'error-message' reads 'Add at least one ballot line, for example 5,Alice>Bob>Cara'
Click the button data-testid 'sample-irv' once, then wait up to 5 seconds until the value of 'ballots-input' contains the line '8,Alice>Bob' (read the textarea's value, not its initial HTML)
